notes: The badge wall is 150 badges now, each one written by hand with its own name and its own goal, instead of the two hundred the threshold tables generated - where most tiles differed from the tile beside them only by a number.
The table that generated those tiles is gone from the app, along with the helper that named them, so no release can grow the wall back by listing one more number.

The dev mode panel is gone from Studio. Seven taps on the version line in Settings still opens the one hidden badge, and that is all it does now - it no longer switches on a test flag or offers to pretend the whole wall is earned.
The five rewards moved with the smaller wall: Cinder at 40 badges, Quartz at 80, Lumen at 110, the dynamic Vortex at 140, and the finished wall at 151 - every badge including the hidden one.

The wall gained badges for the parts of the app that had none: DJ mode and its cue, sync, loop and record controls, the tap tempo, the practice loop, the sleep timer, a tempo read, your own presets, the lyrics panel, shuffle and repeat.
Nothing on the wall asks you to share or alter a song, and nothing counts how late you stay up. Every signal a tile reads is proved against the app by the gate before this release ships.
